# ssp_backup (Resource)

Triggers an on-demand backup for the SSP platform.

Corresponds to `POST /ssp/backup` and `GET /ssp/backup/status/{id}`.

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `backup_type` (String) Type of backup to take. The SSP API currently supports only `FULL_BACKUP`.

### Optional

- `action` (String) Backup action type. The SSP API currently supports only `BACKUP`. Defaults to `BACKUP`.
- `description` (String) Optional description for the backup.
- `name` (String) Optional descriptive name for the backup.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Unique ID of the backup execution job.
- `progress` (Number) Percentage progress of the backup operation.
- `status` (String) Status of the backup execution (`SUCCESS`, `FAILED`, `IN_PROGRESS`).
